h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tadepalligudem

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tadepalligudem

items.pText: Tadepalligudem is a market and college town in West Godavari, in the middle of the Godavari delta's paddy and coconut country. It is home to the National Institute of Technology, Andhra Pradesh, and several other colleges, and many of these campuses house staff families on site. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for such campuses, and for schools and societies in the town, at our factory in Vasai East, about 950 km away.

The delta is hot and humid, with the south-west monsoon from June to September and cyclone rain from the Bay of Bengal later in the year. Our trucks bring the equipment by road, and our installation team or a dealer in south India puts it up on site. Tell us how many families live in the quarters and the ages of their children. We will suggest a set of pieces and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Play areas for staff quarters on a college campus

items.q: Can you supply playground equipment for college staff quarters?
items.a: Yes. Share the size of the open space and the age range of the children living there. We will suggest equipment for younger and older children and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

items.q: Will the equipment cope with humid delta weather?
items.a: The posts are galvanised steel and the slides and panels are roto-moulded plastic, which does not rust. Keep the base well drained so water does not stand around the posts after heavy rain.

items.q: How do you deliver to Tadepalligudem?
items.a: We send the equipment by road from our factory in Vasai East, about 950 km away, and install it through our own installation team or a dealer in south India.
